items.name: theme
items.title: Fragiola theme
items.description: The global stylesheet: @theme inline with the six palette roles, the highlighted and field-focus custom variants, chart token axes, density, radius and --height-control. The chart categorical derivation block lives here (theme machinery, not a palette).

items.name: palette-surface
items.title: Surface palette
items.description: The neutral floor palette. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-raised
items.title: Raised palette
items.description: Elevated surface (card, popover, dialog). Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-brand
items.title: Brand palette
items.description: The project accent colour. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-success
items.title: Success palette
items.description: Confirmation, positive state. Hue ~150. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-warning
items.title: Warning palette
items.description: Caution, attention. Hue ~65. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: palette-danger
items.title: Danger palette
items.description: Error, destructive action. Hue ~25. Applied automatically by [data-invalid]. Both themes, all six roles.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn helper
items.description: clsx + extendTailwindMerge with a palette class group so cn("palette-brand", "palette-danger") resolves to one.

items.name: get-token
items.title: getToken helper
items.description: Reads a CSS custom property from the document, with px/rem formatting and a fallback.

items.name: text
items.title: Text atom
items.description: Heading, Paragraph, Link, Small, Label, Error, Strong, Highlight, Clickable. No react-twc, no router coupling. Text.Link is a plain <a>; consumers wire Next's or TanStack's Link through render.

items.name: icon-size
items.title: iconSize table
items.description: Icon sizes by context as Tailwind classes. The documented escape from 'which size does an icon use here'.
